'''Jono Dunn''' was a [[Galacian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gala]], serving as an attendant to the [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Veda (Galacian)|Veda]] in her royal palace. He had been raised in a family that had been loyal to the [[Beju-Tallah dynasty]], and would always serve them. Dunn considered his life in the palace to be extremely prestigious, and would seek to retain his position there at all costs.<ref name="JA" />

When [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and Obi-Wan Kenobi visited Gala, they found that the queen was being poisoned by an unknown source. Obi-Wan Kenobi eventually discovered that Jono had been secretly poisoning the queen, under the orders of [[Beju]] and [[Lonnag Giba]], in order to maintain his position in the palace. Beju and Giba, with Jono's testimony, were found guilty of trying to remove the queen from power, and [[Wila Prammi]] was elected [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] of Gala in their place. Jono was sent back to his family by Queen Veda to learn farming as a punishment.<ref name="JA" />
